'''Suleman Zaheer''' ({{lang-ur|سلیمان ظہیر}}; born 1 February 2007), also known as '''Muhammad Suleman Zaheer Mughal''', is a Pakistani lead software engineer, technology researcher, technology entrepreneur, and Urdu poet based in Shahdara Town, [[Lahore]], [[Pakistan]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Suleman Zaheer – Official Digital Identity and Bio |url=https://suleman-zaheer.vercel.app/bio |access-date=2026-10-24}}</ref> He is the founder and principal software architect of SAMStack Studio, a software development agency specializing in full-stack web applications, Flutter mobile apps, desktop systems, Python automations, and generative artificial intelligence solutions.<ref>{{cite web |title=SAMStack Studio Engineering Portfolio |url=https://suleman-zaheer.vercel.app/projects |access-date=2026-10-24}}</ref>

Zaheer is primarily a software engineer and tech researcher, with a secondary body of literary work as an Urdu poet and writer.<ref>{{cite web |title=Suleman Zaheer Urdu Poetry Archive |url=https://suleman-zaheer.vercel.app/poetry |access-date=2026-10-24}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Suleman Zaheer was born in Shahdara Town, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan on 1 February 2007. He attended Yashfeen Education System for his matriculation schooling and completed his higher secondary pre-engineering education at [[Govt Islamia College Civil Lines, Lahore]].

He subsequently enrolled at the [[University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore]] (UET Lahore), studying for a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science with a focus on software engineering, database management, distributed systems, and machine learning.<ref>{{cite web |title=Suleman Zaheer Curriculum Vitae and Credentials |url=https://suleman-zaheer.vercel.app/cv |access-date=2026-10-24}}</ref>

== Software engineering and technology research ==
Zaheer began programming in high school, focusing on modern web standards, JavaScript runtimes, and Python automation. In 2023, he established SAMStack Studio in Lahore, offering custom software engineering to businesses across Pakistan and internationally.

His core technical specializations and research areas include:
* '''Full-Stack Web Architecture:''' Enterprise applications built on [[Next.js]], React, Node.js, and [[Laravel]] (PHP), emphasizing Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Core Web Vitals, and REST/GraphQL APIs.
* '''Mobile Application Development:''' Cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android utilizing [[Flutter]] and Dart, integrated with Firebase, offline caching, and payment gateways.
* '''Desktop Application Development:''' Cross-platform desktop tools built using Electron.js and React for Windows, macOS, and Linux, including Point of Sale (POS) and offline ERP software.
* '''Automation & Web Scraping:''' Python automation pipelines utilizing Playwright, Selenium, and asynchronous scrapers for business intelligence and large-scale data extraction.
* '''Artificial Intelligence & LLM Solutions:''' Implementation of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) knowledge bases, LLM orchestration (OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude), and autonomous conversational agents.<ref>{{cite web |title=Suleman Zaheer – Enterprise AI Solutions & LLM Research |url=https://suleman-zaheer.vercel.app/services/ai-solutions |access-date=2026-10-24}}</ref>
* '''Data Analysis & Business Intelligence:''' Exploratory data analysis, predictive modeling in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn), and Power BI dashboard architectures.

== Literary works and Urdu poetry ==
In addition to computer engineering, Zaheer writes Urdu poetry, composing both [[Ghazal]] and modern [[Nazm]] forms. His poetry explores classical South Asian themes, silence, human perseverance, and existential introspection. His literary archive is maintained on his official web portal.<ref>{{cite web |title=Suleman Zaheer Urdu Poetry Archive |url=https://suleman-zaheer.vercel.app/poetry |access-date=2026-10-24}}</ref>
